verdict.rationale: The Nevada Secretary of State is a government service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The probes only show that robots.txt on the front door and the ORION filing portal sit behind bot walls, which does not show that an MCP server exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
